title: Report input
description: Normalized campaign results. Produced from the pipeline's campaign bundle by threetears.evals.analysis.report_input_build.report_input (the kit's adapters/bundle_to_report.py is its first draft, reading a writer message). Statistics are copied through, never recomputed. A control-and-candidates campaign fills the core fields; the optional tasks, factors and configs, target_matrix and cells, confusion, human_pref, criteria and named strata carry what other comparison structures need (GENERATOR.md section 1). The model threetears.evals.analysis.report_input.ReportInput states the same fields, required sets and enums, and a test holds the two together. The r1-r4 references' own JSON is page-shaped synthetic data, not this schema; their report inputs are packages/evals/tests/fixtures/report_plans/r1-r4/input.json.

floors.description: Each floor's status on each candidate.

bars.description: Each arm against each absolute bar.

guardrails.description: Each guardrail check, as the pipeline read it.

scoreboard.description: How each arm's trials came out on the lead aspect, by arm.

factors.description: A factorial grid's factors, in order.

configs.description: Each arm's level of each factor.

confusion.description: Each label axis's confusion, by axis id.

failed_trials.description: The failed trials the run holds per aspect, arm and stratum, which the examples are kept from; none where the input does not count them.

case_overlap.description: For each two aspects, the cases both ran and the cases only one ran; none where the input does not hold the aspects' case ids.

apparatus.description: The rig each run was measured with, for each run that recorded one past a serial run pinning and declaring nothing; none where no run did, or the bundle carried none.

threshold.description: The threshold it was read against.

ApparatusConfound.description: An apparatus setting that may have varied between arms.

id.description: The arm's id, as every by-arm map keys it.

name.description: The campaign's alias for the arm.

short_name.description: The short name the campaign declares for the arm, printed in tight places; none computes one.

role.description: The control, or a candidate measured against it.

served_model.description: The model that served the arm's replies.

settings.description: Model plus every lever that differs from the control (the control lists every lever); a lever an arm leaves out has the control's value.

reasoning_ratio.description: The share of output spent reasoning.

description.description: What kind of candidate the arm is, in a few words.

Arm.description: One arm: what it ran and the part it plays.

name.description: What a reader calls the aspect.

margin.description: The non-inferiority margin, in points; none declared.

asked.description: Whether the campaign's question asks about it.

exploratory_measures.description: Measures read on the aspect but not asked about.

readings.description: Each candidate's reading against the control.

depth.description: How deeply each arm ran it, by arm.

pairs.description: A choice's pair readings on the aspect.

scoreboard.description: How each arm's trials came out on this aspect, by arm; none on the lead aspect (the first asked, else the first), whose scoreboard is the input's own.

description.description: How the aspect is graded, in a sentence or two.

graded_by.description: Whether a judge grades the aspect or a check in code does.

Aspect.description: One aspect the campaign read: its question and each candidate's reading against the control.

aspect.description: The aspect it is read on.

measure.description: What the bar is read on.

bar.description: The threshold, in the measure's units.

value.description: The arm's value on the measure.

interval.description: The interval the status was read on.

BarRead.description: One arm against one absolute bar: met, missed or unclear, as the pipeline read it.

aspects.description: The two aspects' ids, in the input's aspect order.

only_first.description: The cases only the first ran.

only_second.description: The cases only the second ran.

CaseOverlap.description: Whether two aspects ran the same cases: the distinct cases each ran, by their stored ids, shared or not.

confounds.description: Each confound and what it means.

latency.description: Why latency is not compared, when it is not.

Caveats.description: Every disclosure the flag and the method section may need.

per_arm.description: Each arm's figures in the cell: arm, then measure.

Cell.description: One cell of the target matrix and each arm's figures in it.

levels.description: Each factor's level id, by factor id.

Config.description: The level of each factor one arm ran.

labels.description: The labels, in row and column order.

unit.description: row_percent: each row sums to 100; count: observations.

ConfusionTable.description: Where one label axis's predictions went: rows are the expected label, columns the predicted one.

measure.description: The measure or judged dimension, by key.

aspect.description: The aspect it is read on.

verdict.description: improved, regressed, equivalent, not_separated or untested.

delta.description: The arm minus the control, in the measure's units; none when untested.

interval.description: The corrected interval on the delta; none when untested.

confounds.description: Confounds on the contrast, by dimension.

reason.description: Why it is untested or not separated, in one sentence.

Contrast.description: One multiple-comparison-corrected contrast of an arm against the control on one measure.

aspect.description: The aspect whose contrasts it corrects.

merit_axes.description: The declared merit priority; empty when no rule ranks the axes.

correction.description: The correction method, e.g. holm, none.

disclosure.description: What the correction means, in plain words.

ContrastFamily.description: One family of contrasts corrected together.

kind.description: gate: an option failing it is out; floor and bar: they warn; guardrail: a standing must-not-worsen.

measure.description: The measure, judged dimension or aspect it reads, by key.

direction.description: higher_is_better: the value must be at least the threshold; lower_is_better: at most.

threshold.description: The threshold, in the measure's units.

scope.description: overall: the arm's overall value; each_task: every task's value; each_cell: every cell's.

task.description: The one task the criterion applies within.

standing.description: Whether it is standing policy rather than this campaign's.

aspect.description: The aspect whose figures it reads, by id: the lead aspect's are the by-arm maps, any other's its by_aspect figures; none: the lead aspect's (the first asked, else the first).

Criterion.description:
A declared threshold: a gate, floor, bar or guardrail on one measure.

A criterion states the rule; one gate function applies it, so the page, the options and any explore control
cannot disagree. ``floors`` and ``bars`` carry the pipeline's own statuses where it read them.

repeats_per_case.description: Fewest, mean and most repeats a case got.

Depth.description: How deeply one arm ran an aspect.

stratum.description: The stratum or task it falls in.

reason.description: Why it failed: the judge's reason or a note.

excerpt.description: The end of the reply, or what the arm produced.

Example.description: One trial shown as an example, usually a failure.

id.description: The factor's id, as configs and settings key it.

Factor.description: One factor of a factorial grid, or one axis of a target matrix, with its levels in order.

aspect.description: The aspect the slice ran on.

stratum.description: The stratum or task it falls in; none for none.

failed.description: The trials of the slice that failed, as the examples count a failure.

FailedTrials.description: How many trials of one slice of the run failed: the pool its examples are kept from.

aspect.description: The aspect it is read on.

reading.description: The rate that decided the status.

speaks_for.description: The rate the floor speaks for.

interval.description: The interval the status was read on.

worst_drop.description: The largest drop the interval allows, in points.

short_by.description: How far an unclear floor is from held, in points.

FloorRead.description: One floor on one candidate: held, broken or unclear, as the pipeline read it.

HumanPreference.description: Blind side-by-side ratings of the control against one arm.

calibration_ratings.description: Human ratings the judge was calibrated on.

agreement.description: The judge's agreement with those ratings.

level.description: The confidence level of the intervals per_arm carries.

by_aspect.description: Each other aspect's figures, by aspect then arm; per_arm is the lead aspect's (the first asked, else the first).

Judged.description: One judged dimension: its judge and each arm's mean.

criterion.description: What was set: aspect, control, margin, floor, gate.

name.description: Which one, where several could be.

LateCriterion.description: A criterion set after the results were visible.

Level.description: One level of a factor, axis or bin.

unit.description: Its unit, e.g. usd (dollars per reply), pct, ms, s, usd_per_1k (dollars per 1,000 of what the label counts: Cost per 1k conversations), usd_per_1m (dollars per 1,000,000 of what the label counts). A page prints a counted cost per what its label names after the count, and says the count is not stated where the label names none.

merit_axis.description: The merit axis it counts toward.

grade.description: For a rate or score over graded cases, what one case's grade is: a pass or fail, a point on a scale, or a class label right or wrong.

level.description: The confidence level of the intervals per_arm carries.

bins.description: The bins a distribution's shares fall in, in order.

minimum.description: The least the measure can be, where the test set fixes it (a gold call count).

by_aspect.description: Each other aspect's figures, by aspect then arm; per_arm is the lead aspect's (the first asked, else the first).

Measure.description: One measure: what it means and each arm's figure on it.

question.description: The question the campaign asked, in its own words.

behavior.description: The system or behavior under test.

kind.description: The pipeline kind, e.g. change (control + candidates).

kind_means.description: What the kind recommends, in one sentence.

synthetic.description: Whether the data is made up for an example.

volume_per_month.description: Replies or calls per month, when the host declares it; enables monthly cost.

Meta.description: What the campaign was, as the masthead and the method section name it.

arms.description: The two arms' ids, first then second, in the campaign's arm order.

change.description: The first arm minus the second, in points.

interval.description: The interval on the change, in points.

ahead.description: The arm shown ahead; none when neither is.

confirmatory.description: Whether the pair answers the asked question.

passed.description: Each arm's passes, as 'k of n'.

PairRead.description: Two arms of a choice on one aspect: the difference between them, and which one is shown ahead.

common_depth.description: The fewest runs any arm gave a shared case.

shares_no_case.description: Whether the arms share no case at that depth.

unmeasured_for.description: Arms pass^k is not measured for.

said.description: What the pipeline says about it.

PassK.description: Where pass^k is compared, and at what depth.

own_half_width.description: Each arm's own half-width, by arm.

limited_by.description: The arm whose noise limits the interval.

between_case_share.description: The share of the variance that lies between cases.

means.description: What the decomposition means, in one sentence.

Precision.description: What limits a reading's interval at its nominal level.

prefers_control.description: The share of ratings preferring the control, percent.

PreferenceRow.description: Blind human preference in one slice.

confidence.description: How sure the earlier campaign was.

PriorInsight.description: An insight an earlier campaign recorded.

reading.description: The pipeline's verdict, e.g. within_margin, regressed, not_separated.

change.description: The arm minus the control, in points.

within_interval.description: The interval on the change at the nominal level, low then high, in points: what within_margin is read on. None where the aspect declares no margin.

gain_interval.description: The interval on the change at gain_confidence, low then high, in points: what a gain is read on.

margin.description: The margin the reading was read against, in points.

control_passed.description: The control's passes, as 'k of n'.

arm_passed.description: The arm's passes, as 'k of n'.

cases.description: The paired cases the interval rests on.

confirmatory.description: Whether the reading answers the asked question.

Reading.description: One arm's reading on an aspect: its change from the control, with the interval it was read on.

strict_output.description: Whether the request enforced every parameter it carried.

RequestSettings.description: What a role's calls were asked for: the output cap, the reasoning asked, and whether every parameter was enforced.

arm.description: The arm it ran, by id; none for a run the design placed in no arm.

aspect.description: The aspect it ran, by id.

judges.description: The model each judged dimension was asked of; none where not recorded.

judge_asked.description: What every judge call was asked for; none where not recorded.

judge_temperature.description: The temperature judge calls were asked at; none where not recorded.

simulator.description: The simulated user's model; none where none was pinned.

measure_latency.description: Whether latency was declared under test; none where nothing was declared.

arm_schedule.description: How the arm shared time with the other arms; none where not recorded.

cell_concurrency.description: How many of the run's cells executed at once; 1 is serial.

execution_modes.description: The run's results by the execution mode each recorded.

rubric_scales.description: The scale each rubric dimension was answered on.

disclosure.description: What the launching host disclosed about the launch; none where it disclosed nothing.

RunRig.description: The rig one run of one arm was measured with, as the run recorded it at launch.

values.description: Each disclosed value by the host's name for it.

statements.description: What the host states, in its own words.

Disclosure.description: What the launching host disclosed about one run's launch, as it stated it: values by its own names, and its statements of how the run was measured. Shown, never compared: it splits no rig and names no confound.

usable.description: Trials that produced a usable measurement.

test_cost_usd.description: What the arm's trials cost, dollars.

unanswered.description: The arm's unanswered calls by usage role, for each role that counted them; none where no role did (not counted, never none).

pricing.description: How the arm's cost was priced: its price sources, serving providers and priced calls; none where the input does not say.

ScoreboardRow.description: How one arm's trials came out.

note.description: What it lost, and what that does to its rates.

ShortRun.description: A run that produced fewer usable measurements than it was asked for.

mean.description: The mean, in the measure's units.

ci.description: The interval on the mean, low then high.

half_width.description: The interval's half-width, where only that is given.

sem.description: The standard error of the mean.

change.description: The arm minus the control, where only that is given.

shares.description: The share in each of the measure's bins, percent.

Stat.description: One arm's figure on one measure: a mean with its spread, a latency's percentiles, or a distribution.

aspect.description: The aspect whose cases it slices.

dimension.description: The stratification it belongs to, when the input holds more than one.

cost_multiplier.description: Its cost per reply relative to the average.

per_arm.description: Each arm's figures in the stratum: arm, then measure or dimension.

Stratum.description: One stratum: a slice of the cases and each arm's figures in it.

TargetMatrix.description: Two label axes whose product is the cells a classifier is graded in.

description.description: What it covers, in a sentence.

share.description: Its share of traffic, 0 to 1; 0 for a test category.

routable.description: Whether its traffic can be routed to its own arm.

cross_cutting.description: Whether it occurs inside every other task.

per_arm.description: Each arm's figures in the task: arm, then measure or dimension.

Task.description:
A named slice of the work, with each arm's figures in it.

A routable task's traffic can go to its own arm; a cross-cutting one occurs inside every other task, so an arm
serving any traffic must pass it.

sources.description: Each price source its priced calls name (RoleUsage.price_source), sorted.

providers.description: Each provider its calls name as serving them (RoleUsage.provider), sorted; empty where none does.

calls.description: The calls its cost counts; none where a row did not count its.

priced_calls.description: Those of them a price was observed for; none where a row did not count its calls.

Pricing.description: How one arm's cost was priced: what priced its calls, who served them, and how many of them were priced.

retried.description: Calls a forced tool choice was refused on, answered unforced in the same call: attempts and latency, never a failure; none where nothing counted them.

lost.description: Calls sent and never answered, so their turn ended in error: failures the arm's trials already count; none where nothing counted them.

reasons.description: The calls each reason accounts for, by word.

calls.description: The answered calls beside them, which the cost counts; none where uncounted.

share.description: Retried and lost as a share of every call sent, 0 to 1; none where uncounted.

uncounted.description: Trials whose calls in the role counted none, absent from the sums: 'at least'.

Unanswered.description: One role's calls of one arm's trials that went unanswered, beside the arm's cost and never inside it.
